children: OriginTrail has opened its NeuroSymbolic Marketplace to private beta, letting network nodes buy and sell metered AI inference and queries with payment settled in TRAC. The beta introduces a marketplace layer where inference work is priced and exchanged directly between participating nodes.

The mechanism is direct: each metered query or inference call is paid in TRAC, so marketplace activity converts into transaction demand for the token. Whether that produces sustained protocol-level buy pressure depends on the volume the beta attracts and how usage scales once access widens.
Participation is limited to the private phase for now, so early usage figures may not reflect steady-state demand across the full network.
